title: Transformative Change
description: Explores the limitations of conventional approaches to sustainability and considers what transformational—as opposed to incremental—change might require. Emphasis is placed on critical analysis and the skills required for decision-making under conditions of uncertainty, including planning for diverse goals, with incomplete information and sometimes contradictory forms of knowledge. Includes a focus on arts and humanities-based approaches to transformation.
recommendations: TCA 210 recommended prior to or in conjunction with TCA 310.
